content.text:
Done. Installed `typescript` as a dev dependency and added an `npm run typecheck` script (`tsc --noEmit`), using the existing [tsconfig.json](tsconfig.json).

The type error was in [src/pricing/sources.ts](src/pricing/sources.ts): `pricingSources` was an untyped array literal, so TS inferred its element type as a union of the four distinct `PricingSource<Row>` instantiations. Passing a union element into the generic `refreshPricingSource<Row>(source: PricingSource<Row>)` in [src/index.ts:27](src/index.ts:27) made TS infer `Row` from the first union member and reject the rest. Fixed by explicitly typing `pricingSources: PricingSource<unknown>[]` — sound here since `refreshPricingSource` only stores the parsed rows and never inspects their shape.

`npm run typecheck` now passes clean.

After changing any `.ts` file, run in this order:

```bash
npm run lint
```

```bash
npm run format
```

- `npm run lint` runs `oxlint` with its default rule set. Fix any
  reported errors before continuing.
- `npm run format` runs `oxfmt` with its default settings and rewrites
  files in place. Run it again after fixing lint errors, since edits
  can reintroduce formatting drift.
- Re-run `npm start` to confirm the code still runs correctly under
  Node's TS support after linting/formatting.

Repeat edit → lint → format until `oxlint` reports no issues and
`oxfmt` makes no further changes.

After changing any `.ts` file, run in this order:

```bash
npm run typecheck
```

```bash
npm run lint
```

```bash
npm run format
```

- `npm run typecheck` runs `tsc --noEmit` to type-check `src`. Fix any
  reported type errors before continuing.
- `npm run lint` runs `oxlint` with its default rule set. Fix any
  reported errors before continuing.
- `npm run format` runs `oxfmt` with its default settings and rewrites
  files in place. Run it again after fixing lint errors, since edits
  can reintroduce formatting drift.
- Re-run `npm start` to confirm the code still runs correctly under
  Node's TS support after linting/formatting.

Repeat edit → typecheck → lint → format until `tsc` and `oxlint`
report no issues and `oxfmt` makes no further changes.
